strings.name: Park Chan-wook
strings.summary: Park Chan-wook’s precise compositions, moral dilemmas and genre storytelling shaped a distinctive style. From Joint Security Area to his revenge trilogy and The Handmaiden, his films broadened Korean cinema’s international audience. A Cannes prizewinner for Oldboy and Decision to Leave, he chaired the festival’s 2026 feature-film jury.
